<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">9:41</text>
    <line x1="327" y1="16" x2="327" y2="20" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="13" x2="331" y2="20" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="10" x2="335" y2="20" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="16" r="3" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="20" x2="350" y2="13" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="13" x2="355" y2="20" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="364" y="11" width="18" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="366" y="13" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
    <rect x="383" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="125" r="70" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="125" r="54" fill="#DB6186" opacity="0.12"/>
    <polygon points="161,136 207,107 226,108 211,116 230,122 226,127 204,123 183,143 176,141 190,124 168,132" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <polygon points="189,124 194,101 200,99 200,121" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <polygon points="190,125 175,112 171,114 181,130" fill="#932B5E"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="111" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="111" r="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="234" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Welcome back</text>
  <text x="195" y="262" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Sign in to continue your journey</text>

  <!-- Form -->
  <g>
    <text x="30" y="307" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Email address</text>
    <rect x="30" y="317" width="330" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="343" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="45,343 52,343 59,343" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="72" y="348" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">alex.morgan@email.com</text>

    <text x="30" y="404" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Password</text>
    <rect x="30" y="414" width="330" height="52" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="46" y="434" width="13" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="49,434 49,430 56,430 56,434" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="327" cy="440" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="449" x2="336" y2="431" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="72" y="445" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="3" fill="#323232">••••••••</text>

    <text x="360" y="493" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Forgot password?</text>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="30" y="516" width="330" height="52" rx="8" fill="#7A1851"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="549" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Sign in</text>

    <line x1="30" y1="598" x2="166" y2="598" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="598" x2="360" y2="598" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="603" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#A8A8AC">or continue with</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="30" y="622" width="330" height="50" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="54" cy="647" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="54" y="652" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#DB6186">G</text>
      <text x="195" y="652" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Continue with Google</text>
    </g>

    <text x="195" y="715" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">New to Airplane?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="30" y="731" width="330" height="48" rx="8" fill="#DB6186"/>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="762" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Create an account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="798" width="390" height="46" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="798" x2="390" y2="798" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="44,815 52,808 60,815" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="47" y="814" width="10" height="10" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="52" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="817" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="130" y1="817" x2="136" y2="811" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="130" cy="817" r="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
      <text x="130" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Explore</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Trips -->
    <g>
      <rect x="207" y="809" width="17" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="211" y1="806" x2="211" y2="812" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="806" x2="220" y2="812" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="211" y1="816" x2="220" y2="816" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <text x="216" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Trips</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Account -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="327" cy="813" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="327" cy="823" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="327" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Account</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
